<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
  <title>Pose applique — Baie coulissante</title>
  <desc>Schéma en applique pour Baie coulissante</desc>
  <!-- Masque: croix hachurée pour la maçonnerie -->
  <defs>
    <pattern id="brick" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="20" height="10">
      <rect width="20" height="10" fill="#a89888"/>
      <path d="M0 0 L20 0 M0 5 L10 5 M10 10 L20 10 M0 0 L0 10 M20 0 L20 10" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="0.6"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="iso" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="14" height="14" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
      <rect width="14" height="14" fill="#e8e0d0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="14" stroke="#a89888" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <!-- Mur maçonnerie gauche -->
  <rect x="0" y="40" width="90.0" height="200" fill="url(#brick)" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Mur maçonnerie droite -->
  <rect x="310.0" y="40" width="90.0" height="200" fill="url(#brick)" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>  <!-- Fond d'ouverture -->
  <rect x="90.0" y="60" width="220.0" height="160" fill="#f5f0e8" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Triangles d'ouverture (convention: triangles = limites de l'ouverture brute) -->
  <polygon points="90.0,60 102.0,60 90.0,72" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="310.0,60 298.0,60 310.0,72" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="90.0,220 102.0,220 90.0,208" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="310.0,220 298.0,220 310.0,208" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="200.0" y="145.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#5a4a3a">Ouverture</text>  <rect x="315.0" y="50" width="110.0" height="180" fill="none" stroke="#7a5c3e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="319.0" y="54" width="102.0" height="172" fill="#f5f0e8" stroke="#7a5c3e" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="370.0" y="144.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#7a5c3e">Ouvrant</text>
  <text x="440.0" y="140.0" font-size="10" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#7a5c3e">← Applique</text>
  <!-- Solin / rejingot -->
  <rect x="312.0" y="230" width="116.0" height="6" fill="#9a8a78" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="0.8"/>  <!-- Cote largeur -->
  <g stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
    <line x1="90.0" y1="280" x2="310.0" y2="280"/>
    <line x1="90.0" y1="275" x2="90.0" y2="285"/>
    <line x1="310.0" y1="275" x2="310.0" y2="285"/>
  </g>
  <text x="200.0" y="295" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#5a4a3a">Largeur</text>  <!-- Cote hauteur -->
  <g stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
    <line x1="385" y1="60" x2="385" y2="220"/>
    <line x1="380" y1="60" x2="390" y2="60"/>
    <line x1="380" y1="220" x2="390" y2="220"/>
  </g>
  <text x="395" y="140.0" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#5a4a3a">Hauteur</text>  <text x="200" y="295" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#3a2a1a">Pose APPLIQUE — Baie coulissante</text>
</svg>

  <title>Pose renovation — Fenêtre</title>
  <desc>Schéma en rénovation pour Fenêtre</desc>
  <!-- Masque: motif brique pour la maçonnerie -->
  <defs>
    <pattern id="brick" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="20" height="10">
      <rect width="20" height="10" fill="#a89888"/>
      <path d="M0 0 L20 0 M0 5 L10 5 M10 10 L20 10 M0 0 L0 10 M20 0 L20 10" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="0.6"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="iso" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="14" height="14" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
      <rect width="14" height="14" fill="#e8e0d0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="14" stroke="#a89888" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <!-- Mur maçonnerie gauche (brique) -->
  <rect x="0" y="40" width="90.0" height="200" fill="url(#brick)" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Mur maçonnerie droite (brique) -->
  <rect x="310.0" y="40" width="90.0" height="200" fill="url(#brick)" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Fond d'ouverture brute -->
  <rect x="90.0" y="60" width="220.0" height="160" fill="#f5f0e8" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Triangles d'ouverture brute aux 4 coins -->
  <polygon points="90.0,60 102.0,60 90.0,72" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="310.0,60 298.0,60 310.0,72" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="90.0,220 102.0,220 90.0,208" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="310.0,220 298.0,220 310.0,208" fill="#d94f2a" stroke="#5a4a3a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="200.0" y="145.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#5a4a3a">Ouverture brute</text>
  <!-- Ancien dormant conservé -->
  <rect x="110.0" y="50" width="180" height="180" fill="#b0a090" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <text x="105.0" y="60" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#666">Ancien dormant</text>
